// Test Case 1: Query and Display Patient Details
start PatientInterface -> DoctorInterface
    request "Query Patient Id: <ID>"
    expect DoctorInterface responds with "Display Patient Details"
    request "Modify Patient Details"
    expect DoctorInterface responds with "Error: Patient pin-code cannot be modified outside the Zone"

// Test Case 2: Query and Modify Patient Details
start PatientInterface -> DoctorInterface
    request "Query Patient Id: <ID>"
    expect DoctorInterface responds with "Display Patient Details"
    request "Modify Patient Details"
    expect DoctorInterface responds with "Error: Patient pin-code cannot be modified outside the Zone"

// Test Case 3: Query and Enter Appointment Details
start PatientInterface -> DoctorInterface
    request "Query Patient Id: <ID>"
    expect DoctorInterface responds with "Display Patient Details"
    request "Enter Appointment Details"
    expect DoctorInterface responds with "Enter Speciality, Symptoms, Consultation Request, Appointment Date"
    input "Speciality: Cardiology", "Symptoms: Chest Pain", "Consultation Request: Yes", "Appointment Date: Tomorrow"
    expect DoctorInterface creates "Appointment Entry"

// Test Case 4: Doctor Consultation Workflow
start DoctorInterface
    for each "Consultation Request" from PatientInterface
        request "Select Consultation Request"
        expect DoctorInterface sees request
        request "Provide Consultation"
        expect DoctorInterface provides "Diagnosis" and "Prescribes Medicines (max 8)"
        input "Prescribes Medicines: Medicine1, Medicine2, ..., Medicine8"
        expect DoctorInterface requests "Lab Tests (max 5)"

// Test Case 5: Chemist Medication Workflow
start ChemistInterface
    for each "Prescription" from DoctorInterface
        request "Select Prescription"
        expect ChemistInterface sees prescription
        request "Dispense Medicines"
        input "Medicines: Medicine1, Medicine2, ..., Medicine8"
        expect ChemistInterface marks "Dispensed Flag"
        request "Note Lab Requests"
        input "Patient Details: <ID>", "Lab Tests: Test1, Test2, ..., Test5"
        expect ChemistInterface marks "Lab Requests Flag"

// Test Case 6: Lab Test Workflow
start LabInterface
    for each "Lab Request" from ChemistInterface
        request "Select Lab Request"
        expect LabInterface sees request
        request "Note Down Tests"
        input "Tests: Test1, Test2, ..., Test5"
        expect LabInterface marks "Tests Noted Down Flag"

// Test Case 7: Boundary Condition for Maximum Medicines
start ChemistInterface
    for each "Prescription" with max 8 medicines
        request "Select Prescription"
        expect ChemistInterface sees prescription
        request "Dispense Medicines"
        input "Medicines: Medicine1, Medicine2, ..., Medicine8"
        expect ChemistInterface marks "Dispensed Flag"

// Test Case 8: Boundary Condition for Maximum Lab Tests
start LabInterface
    for each "Lab Request" with max 5 tests
        request "Select Lab Request"
        expect LabInterface sees request
        request "Note Down Tests"
        input "Tests: Test1, Test2, ..., Test5"
        expect LabInterface marks "Tests Noted Down Flag"

// Test Case 9: Negative Path - Invalid Pin-Code Modification
start PatientInterface
    request "Query Patient Id: <INVALID_PIN_CODE>"
    expect PatientInterface responds with "Error: Invalid Pin-Code"

// Test Case 10: Negative Path - No Appointment Request
start PatientInterface
    request "Query Patient Id: <ID>"
    expect PatientInterface responds with "Display Patient Details"

// Test Case 11: Negative Path - No Consultation Request
start DoctorInterface

        no request
        expect DoctorInterface does not respond

// Test Case 12: Negative Path - No Prescription Entry
start ChemistInterface
    for each "No Prescription Entry" from DoctorInterface
        no request
        expect ChemistInterface does not respond

start LabInterface
    for each "No Lab Request" from ChemistInterface
        no request
        expect LabInterface does not respond

start PatientInterface
    request "Query Patient Id: <ID>"
    expect PatientInterface responds with "Display Patient Details"

    input "Speciality: Cardiology", "Symptoms: Chest Pain", "Consultation Request: Yes", "Appointment Date: INVALID_DATE"
    expect PatientInterface responds with "Error: Invalid Appointment Date"

// Test Case 15: Error Path - Invalid Prescription Input
start ChemistInterface
    request "Select Prescription"
    expect ChemistInterface responds with "Error: Invalid Prescription Input"

// Test Case 16: Error Path - No Response from Systems
start PatientInterface
    request "Query Patient Id: <ID>"
    request "Enter Appointment Details"
    input "Speciality: Cardiology", "Symptoms: Chest Pain", "Consultation Request: Yes", "Appointment Date: Tomorrow"

// Test Case 17: Error Path - No Response from Doctor

        request "Select Prescription"
        no request
        expect ChemistInterface does not respond

start LabInterface

    expect PatientInterface receives "Appointment Entry Created"
